title: DP-50…DP-200 / DGP-100…DGP-200 - Deesys Voltage & Grounding Voltage Transformer 0.72 kV
range_short_desc: Single-phase voltage transformer (VT) and grounding PT (GPT)
description: Deesys single-phase voltage transformers (V.T) and grounding voltage transformers (GPT) rated 0.72 kV, for indoor metering and relaying. Epoxy mould, brown ABS non-flammable case. V.T models DP-50/100/200 (and F variants) with 50/100/200 VA burden; GPT models DGP-100/200 and DGP-100T/200T (and F/TF variants) with a tertiary winding for earth-fault detection.

feature_groups.title: Main Feature
items: Single phase, for metering and relaying, indoor use
Colour: brown; case: ABS non-flammable; mould: epoxy
GPT versions provide a tertiary (3ry) winding for earth-fault relaying
